assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 hero image for a family-friendly browser motion game
Primary request: An original, magical night museum scene where playful marble statues come alive to dance, then freeze when a museum guard's flashlight sweeps through the gallery.
Scene/backdrop: Grand but welcoming museum gallery after closing, indigo-blue night visible through high windows, marble plinths and archways, subtle museum display details.
Subject: A small ensemble of whimsical, fully clothed, non-photorealistic marble statues caught in expressive freeze poses; a warm cone of flashlight crosses the floor, with the guard only suggested as a distant friendly silhouette.
Style/medium: Premium storybook-meets-editorial digital illustration, painterly 3D depth, soft sculptural forms, suitable for children ages 3–7 without looking babyish.
Composition/framing: Wide cinematic 16:9 establishing shot, clear central tableau, strong depth, edge-safe crop, no UI or captions baked into the art.
Lighting/mood: Moonlit indigo shadows, warm brass-gold museum lamps and flashlight, ivory marble highlights; mysterious but cozy, joyful and non-scary.
Color palette: Deep indigo and midnight blue, warm ivory marble, restrained brass and antique gold accents; high readable contrast.
Materials/textures: Fine marble veining, brushed brass, polished stone floor with subtle reflections, painterly atmosphere.
Constraints: Original characters only; no children or real people; no recognizable copyrighted characters; no logos; no trademarks; no text; no letters; no numbers; no signage; no watermark; no deceptive UI; no danger; no running or unsafe movement; fully clothed statues; family friendly.
Avoid: Horror, threatening guard, dark illegible faces, photorealistic children, weapons, clutter, neon colors, lime green, coral red, overly cute stock-vector style.
